spec.loader: scripts/panel_screen.py (opt-in; the published TILT-ERA face still reads e27.load_universe() unmodified)
spec.faces: E42 ladder tilt by era, rebuilt per arm from the same monthly core builder the published twin uses

honest: eras are calendar partitions of one continuous monthly series; each row is measured on its own months, so the era tilt bp do not add up to the full-sample number
the decomposition is the E40 identity (2/5 large + 3/5 small) applied per era; the regression is descriptive, not a factor-model estimate
the newest era is open-ended and the shortest, so its beta carries the widest error
corporate-action guard as in E40: months with a >20% single-day member jump are dropped
descriptive census only: no gate, no verdict, no prereg, no trial count

neutralise_int repairs only prints whose price ratio lands on an integer; neutralise repairs every adjacent print -- the range between them bounds the correction
